job.job_description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the worlds mostinnovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as theyprovide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days arethe same.


Your Role


Own and define enterprisescale AIOps, GenAI, and Agentic AI platform strategy across multiple clients/accounts.
Act as final technical authority for architecture, design reviews, risk mitigation, and production readiness.
Lead operations and governance, including CAB ownership, platform stability, SLAs, KPIs, and continuous improvement.
Drive industrialized adoption of GenAI & Agentic AI, converting PoCs into secure, scalable, production solutions delivering measurable business outcomes.
Lead, mentor, and manage multilocation AI/Automation teams, while advising senior stakeholders and supporting presales and roadmap decisions.




Your Profile


Overall 12-14 Years
GenAI & Agentic AI: Azure OpenAI / AWS Bedrock, LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, autonomous/semiautonomous agents.
AIOps & Automation: UiPath / Automation Anywhere / Power Automate with strong architecture and governance experience.
Operations & ITIL: CAB ownership, Incident/Problem/Change/Knowledge Management, SLAs, MTTR, cost optimization.
Programming & Platforms: Python (mandatory), REST APIs, ITSM (ServiceNow), cloud platforms (Azure & AWS).
Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Strong people management, CXO communication, business translation, and opsfirst decision making.
